mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telegram_user (chat_id, username, first_name, lang) VALUES (#{chatId}, #{username}, #{firstName}, COALESCE(#{lang},'mn')) ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE SET username = EXCLUDED.username, first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE telegram_user SET state = #{state}, state_data = #{stateData}::jsonbNULL, updated_at = now() WHERE chat_id = #{chatId}
UPDATE telegram_user SET phone = #{phone}, updated_at = now() WHERE chat_id = #{chatId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telegram_outbox (chat_id, kind, payload, sent_ok) VALUES (#{chatId}, #{kind}, #{payload}, #{sentOk})
